definitions.explanation: A large body of salt water. Japan, being an island nation, has a strong connection to the sea.

examples.japanese: {夏|なつ}は{海|うみ}に{行|い}きます。
examples.english: I go to the sea in summer.

examples.japanese: {海|うみ}で{泳|およ}ぎたいです。
examples.english: I want to swim in the sea.
The sea is beautiful, isn't it?

notes: 海 (umi) is the general word for sea or ocean. As an island nation, Japan has a deep cultural connection to the sea. Related words: 海水浴 (kaisuiyoku, sea bathing), 海岸 (kaigan, seashore). The Sea of Japan is 日本海 (Nihonkai).
